title: Project Foundation (D1)
objective: Establish project structure, agentic worksurface, and development environment before writing application code
scope: Project directory scaffold, agent surface, engineering standards, build environment, project documentation
why_now: M1 and M3 require foundation before implementation. This is the first workstream.

recent_updates.summary: Foundation workstream completed. Audit conducted (docs/review/audit-v0.1.0.md), systems redesigned (combat decomposed into targeting/attack/combat-skills, merchant absorbed into objective), Phase 2 and Phase 3 contracts authored, game-api.md and context-map.md created. Agentic surface updated with new directives (D4-D6), game reference context, and current progress tracking. Implementation workstream created to track next phase.
Phase 1 contracts authored: world-model.md, configuration.md, logging.md. Signal catalog updated.
Phase 0 prerequisites complete. esbuild build pipeline set up. Scheduler and event bus contracts authored.
Documentation structure and project scaffold established. Requirements (R1-R50), architecture, contracts index, roadmap, agent surface.
